summary_bullets: Accept attestation-only aggregate empty merges as REASON=ok with MERGED_COUNT=0 and whitespace-only persisted findings.
Reject attestation plus malformed pseudo-heading output through the new nonconforming_heading_with_attestation narrow trigger.
Update aggregate-findings tests, sibling docs, SECURITY.md, and CHANGELOG.md for the #2939 empty-merge contract.
commit_message:
Fix aggregate empty-merge attestation semantics (#2939)

Accept attestation-only duplicate merges as REASON=ok with MERGED_COUNT=0 and a whitespace-only persisted ballot. Add a nonconforming_heading_with_attestation narrow trigger for malformed pseudo-headings that also include the attestation token, and update the aggregate harness plus docs for the corrected contract.
todos_left: Full make lint could not complete without environment overrides in this sandbox because test-upsert-diagrams-comment writes to <OPERATOR_REPO_PATH>/larch/sessions, outside the writable roots; rerun outside the sandbox or with XDG_CACHE_HOME under an allowed root for a complete full-suite pass.
